source.section: Schedule 2 line 11 code 601 and PDF pages 19-20 Civil Service Annuity Deduction (PDF page 19: 'The lesser of the amount of taxable civil service annuity income ... or $16,000, Less all amounts of Social Security income and tier 1 and tier 2 Railroad Retirement income ... received by the civil service annuitant'), with its examples (PDF page 20 Matthew and Claire example); Schedule 2 line 5 (PDF page 17 Lines 5 and 6); Schedule 3 line 1 (PDF page 24: joint 2,000, all other filers 1,000), line 4 (PDF page 25: 1,000 age 65 or older), line 5 (PDF page 25: 500 age 65 or older and IT-40 line 1 under 40,000, or under 20,000 married filing separately); Form IT-40 lines 1-8 (PDF page 1; line 8 'multiply line 7 by 3% (.03)'); booklet PDF page 8 Line 1; PDF pages 5-6 rounding

worked: Federal AGI = federal civil service annuity person 0 13,700.00 + federal civil service annuity person 1 21,900.00 + taxable Social Security 8,975.00 = 44,575.00. Social Security received: person 0 17,500.00, person 1 6,300.00; the federal taxable amount from the federal worksheet is 8,975.00. Federal taxable income = 44,575.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 - 2 x 1,600.00 age 65 additional = 9,875.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Indiana starts from federal AGI). Form IT-40 line 1 federal AGI 44,575.00. Line 2 add-backs 0.00; line 3 = 44,575.00 + 0.00 = 44,575.00. Civil service annuity person 0, Matthew (age 68): lesser of the taxable annuity 13,700.00 and 16,000.00 = 13,700.00; less his own Social Security received 17,500.00 and railroad retirement 0.00 = -3,800.00, so 0.00 (the booklet: no deduction). Civil service annuity person 1, Claire (age 68): lesser of the taxable annuity 21,900.00 and 16,000.00 = 16,000.00; less her own Social Security received 6,300.00 and railroad retirement 0.00 = 9,700.00 (the booklet: 9,700). Each annuitant's own Social Security is used, the gross amount received. Total 0.00 + 9,700.00 = 9,700.00. Schedule 2: line 5 taxable Social Security 8,975.00; line 11 code 601 civil service annuity 9,700.00; line 12 total = 18,675.00. IT-40 line 4 = 18,675.00. Line 5 = 44,575.00 - 18,675.00 = 25,900.00. Schedule 3: line 1 2,000.00; line 4 2 x 1,000.00 = 2,000.00; line 5 IT-40 line 1 44,575.00 is not less than 40,000.00: none; line 7 total = 4,000.00. IT-40 line 6 = 4,000.00. Line 7 = 25,900.00 - 4,000.00 = 21,900.00. Line 8 = 21,900.00 x 0.03 = 657.00. No credits; county tax (line 9) is local and out of scope. State income tax 657.00.
